title: YouTube Just Demonetized My Channel...
description:
After a series of frustrating events and no help, YouTube demonetized my channel for 30+ days. Can't seem to find any help and just needed to vent

Jonathan
transcript: So, this is the last dang video I wanted to be making right now, but YouTubeseemingly has demonetized my channel. Sometimes when it rains, it pours. Iguess I'm coming fresh off a double root canal, which is honestly fine. It wassomething I knew was coming just with the couple years of health problems.Dental hygiene wasn't exactly at the top of my list with eye scarring and braintrauma, but just like everything else, it was one thing I was trying to takecare of. So, after that, this really wasn't the best news. And I've hadproblems with AdSense on this channel for months now to the point where Ihaven't been able to get any kind of payment at all. I honestly hate money somuch. And that was one of my points last year with that initial comeback video isjust, hey, as much as this burns my soul and as hard as it is to ask, I need somehelp now just to the point where I can get back on my feet and then do it on myown. So to work and work and just really get back to this place where I feel likefinally I can do it on my own and for this to happen is just reallyfrustrating. One of my life's mission now is just to work and work andeventually get back to a place where everybody that helped out especially onthe GoFundMe, I want to pay them back because something that absolutely justreally messes with me is I've had even close friends say, "Oh, I thought youwere doing really good because your GoFundMe did really well." And it's justlike, man, I don't know if you really understood how hard things were andsometimes still are. There are still ongoing treatments and therapies, and itwasn't just this one-time thing. It's something that I have to work for everysingle day. It's almost a full-time job. And again, now I just feel like I'm backat that place where I can put in the work and just make good stuff and letyou guys watch. So essentially what happened is once everything shut downwith the business, I of course had to remove the bank account, but that seemedto open up the door of problems. I haven't had any luck with the currentAdSense account. So I tried to close it and start a new one. Unfortunately, itwouldn't let me close the old account because there's a balance there. Andonce I tried to create a new account, it rejected that because it thought it wasa duplicate. So I'm trapped in AdSense hell. And ultimately what happened is itended up locking my account for specifically 32 days. And honestly Icould deal with that. I can wait another 32 days. But the bigger problem isaltogether it demonetized my channel completely. So it's not a situationwhere I could just keep working or making videos for the next 30 days whileit acrews or builds like it has. It's just shut down altogether. Now, theother part of social media and YouTube that I really have come to despise isjust the entitlement, right? Everything with this I've tried to do by the books,not behind the scenes, but through support, through the right avenues. Icontacted both YouTube and Google support and finally got a hold ofsomeone today. But the end result was, "Oh, we're sorry, but yeah, there'snothing we can do. you can't monetize your channel at least for the next 30days. I tried to calmly explain things in the situation that I've had thischannel since somewhere around 2011. I've never had problems. I'm not askingfor any handouts, but hey guys, it would be really helpful if now during thebusiest time of the year where I'm actually able to make videos and takeadvantage of things, if I could actually have an AdSense account. Even now,things like Patreon are cool, but really all I want to ask from you guys is justto watch videos. I just want to work hard. I want to create cool stuff andjust have you guys watch it because that's really all I need. And it feelslike right now I can't even have that. I was working on another video that I wastrying to post today. And I think the other outside problem on top of themonetization is not even just the money, but how YouTube and the algorithm pushesyour videos. because if it's not monetized, then they're going topotentially push it less. So, it's a whole other world of frustrating. I'mnot really sure what to do right now. I tried to go the correct avenues andcontact support or reach out through Twitter x YouTube creators and reallyjust don't ever get any kind of answers. Either way, I don't think it stops mefrom making videos, but I'm just frustrated and more than anything justwanted a place to talk and chat. you see these highlight stories about how muchYouTube cares about creators and I will say absolutely I see that all the time.I'm so grateful to get to post here and the fact that this can be a career or away to make a living, but it doesn't negate how frustrating this is and alsojust the lack of empathy with the responses today when you already don'tget much of a response and you're kind of tied and in limbo for months andcan't get it fixed and then try to take that step to fix it yourself only tohave it backfire and turn out a h 100 times worse. just it kind of just makesyou want to bang your head on the desk. So, I'm not sure if anybody out therehas any kind of answers. I've never personally got to talk to anybody atYouTube over these years. I'm just kind of sitting out here in the dark. There'sno wolves. I'm not hungry, but I just want to make videos and this just seemedlike a giant way to stop that right now. Of course, it doesn't. I'm gonna keepmaking videos, but I would love to resolve this just because it is a giantpain. And again, I'm just at the point where again, I don't want to ask foranything. I just want to work hard, keep making stuff, and really just do itbecause I can. And you guys got me to this place. So, anybody out there,YouTube,I could use your help. Thank you.
